Dialog.title: 'Welcome to your trial'
Dialog.p: This is a quick orientation to how your trial works - not a product tour. Here's what to know before you dive in.

ul.li: Seats - your trial has a fixed seat cap; each teammate who joins takes one of those seats.
Expiry & extension - your trial expires on the date shown in the systray; ask your sales contact for an extension before it lapses.
Inviting teammates - you can invite teammates yourself, up to the seat cap, without routing it through factory1.
Suspend & Wake - idle instances suspend automatically to save cost; a "Wake Up" action brings yours back in a minute or two.

t.a: View the full Getting Started guide
